constraints: Can only be called from 4D remote or 4D single-user applications; not allowed on 4D Server.
Scope is the current session only; a later CHANGE CURRENT USER call resets memberships defined by this command.
Group names that do not exist are silently ignored.
A license used via a "serialized" group membership stays attached to the user account until the session ends, even if that membership is later canceled by this command.

overloadMerges.note: Adds sentinel meanings for the empty-collection and omitted-parameter cases of groups, distinguishing them from an ordinary populated collection.

sentinelValues.meaning: the 4D user account will no longer belong to any group
resets the account's group memberships to those stored on disk
